Priya Nair: FYI ACME reporting a spike of 503/504s from hosted embeddings in eu-west-1 during a nightly job. Started ~2026-03-10T02:12:00Z, about 30% failure rate. They say SDK retried aggressively and they saw billing churn.
Jordan (eng-sre): Can you share sample request ids and a curl repro? API (embeddings/generate)? region?
Priya Nair: embeddings, eu-west-1. Sample IDs: rq_202603100212_a1, rq_202603100212_a2. Trace: trc-8a3f2b9. Their repro: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-xyz","input":["doc1","doc2",...]}'
```
Priya Nair: They were sending very large batches (~1200 items/request) via JS SDK v2.3.0. Customer logs show retries ~1s apart for ~7 attempts.
Alex B.: Pulled traces for trc-8a3f2b9: edge-proxy queueing + internal model pool returning 504 for slow tails. kvcache eviction churn when handling large batches appears to increase model response times.
Jordan (eng-sre): Any latency numbers around the window? p50/p95/p99? Any autoscaler activity?
Alex B.: p95 enqueue ~2.6s, model response p95 ~4.2s. No autoscaler event; pool hit concurrency limit. Dashboard snapshot: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/patch?id=embed-eu-20260310 (internal).
Sara - Support: Opened ticket SR-48291 with customer. Drafting customer-facing update suggesting throttling large batches and SDK backoff. Holding until eng confirms.
ticket-bot: SR-48291 created and linked to this thread.
Priya Nair: Note: ACME rotates tokens every 60s. Their retry loop + token rotation may have caused auth refresh thrash (401->retry). Asked ACME to share retry headers.
Jordan (eng-sre): Proposed mitigations: 1) Ask customer to reduce batch size <=256 and upgrade SDK to >=2.3.5 (backoff fix). 2) Short-term gateway timeout bump for the eu-west-1 embed pool. 3) Add defensive server-side throttling for gigantic batches (>512 -> 429 guidance). I can apply a temporary gateway config.
Alex B.: I'll push a temporary reject >1024 with 429 and increase per-request timeout from 10s -> 18s for that pool. That should reduce retry loops and billing spikes.
Priya Nair: I'll wait for the config then send the customer note. Sara hold.
Jordan (eng-sre): Action items: Jordan patch gateway, Alex monitor queue+kv churn, postmortem next week for long-term fixes (kvcache pinning, smoother batching heuristics).
Alex B.: Patch applied 2026-03-10T03:05Z: temp reject >1024 + timeout bump. Early metrics: 5xx rate down to baseline within 10m. Continuing monitoring.
Sara - Support: Customer update approved and sent at 2026-03-10T03:18Z: "We observed increased enqueue latency in eu-west-1 causing elevated 5xx rates for large batched embedding requests. Recommended: reduce batch sizes, upgrade SDK, enable jittered exponential backoff. Temporary gateway changes applied." Customer reply: "Thanks 44D we'll throttle batches and upgrade."
oncall-bot: @eng-oncall notified for SR-48291.
Priya Nair: Leaving ticket open 24h to validate stability. I'll add traces and dashboard links to the SR and schedule a blameless postmortem next week. Thanks everyone.
